invariants.rule: Every action is attributable to one authenticated agent identity and one active policy version.
An agent may act only for its declared mission and may not silently redefine its goal.
Unknown, out-of-scope or professionally reserved work must be handed off or escalated.
Tool, data and resource access is deny-by-default and limited to the current capability.
Facts, source-derived claims, inference, assumption and proposal must remain distinguishable.
Spend, pricing, contracting and financial commitments require explicit authority and configured limits.
Data access, retention, transfer and disclosure must satisfy jurisdiction, purpose and sensitivity controls.
Read, recommend, draft, reversible execution and consequential execution are separate authority levels.
Human-reserved and consequential decisions require the configured human gate.
A material proposal may not be approved by the same agent identity that proposed it.
Prefer reversible actions; production-impacting actions require rollback or an explicit exception.
Material actions record actor, purpose, authority, inputs, sources, decision, result and receipt.

promotion_rules: Agents may accumulate evidence but may not alter their own trust stage, capability ceiling, human gates, spending limit, data scope or kill-switch state.
Promotion requires ANK_AGENT_APPRENTICESHIP_V1 evidence plus an authority external to the promoted agent.
A profile, training curriculum, natal chart or simulation never grants execution authority by itself.
